description: This file defines the SesV2Client class within the Aws\SesV2 namespace, which is a client used to interact with the Amazon Simple Email Service (SES) v2 API. It contains method annotations for various SES operations, indicating that this class acts as a client interface for SES. The class extends AwsClient, integrating with the AWS SDK's core client functionality.

classes.name: SesV2Client
classes.description: Client class for Amazon SES v2, providing methods for email service operations.

methods.name: batchGetMetricData
methods.description: Retrieves batch metric data from SES.
